items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Beyond the Blue Horizon was the first record with Creed Taylor.

ctx.x: Beyond the Blue Horizon. Excuse me. That’s right.
Beyond the Blue Horizon, and then we did – the second album I think was – no. Beyond the Blue Horizon was the first record with Creed Taylor. There’s some before that.
The Other Side of Abbey Road is on A&M.
